questions.question: Briefly explain the preparation of traditional Indian sweets like peda and burfi.
questions.solution_html: • Briefly explain the preparation of traditional Indian sweets like peda and burfi. Peda :- Broken the Koha into bits, Mix with sugar, Put into a Pan and cook over a very slow fire, pour into a greased tray. After cool and set, cut into desired size and shape. Burfi :- 4 to 5 litres of buffalo milk is heated in a stainless-steel kettle with constant stirring to prevent scorching. When semisolid consistency is reached, stop heating, and add powdered sugar, mix well using a wooden ladle until uniform, smooth mass is formed. Then, pour the mixture into a greased tray. questions.question: What is beeswax?
questions.solution_html: • What is beeswax? Beeswax is a natural wax produced by honeybees by using their four pairs of wax glands situated on the anterior part of the worker’s last four normal sternal plates. Bees secrete it as a liquid that hardens into scales upon contact with air, and they use these scales to build the hexagonal cells of their honeycomb. It is composed mainly of esters of fatty acids and long-chain alcohols, free fatty acids, hydrocarbons and other minor components (eg. Carotenoids, propolis etc.). (Definition- (2 Marks) , Composition- (1 mark) /

• Explain the nutritional significance of eggs. Describe different egg products and its advantages Nutritional significance :
  • - Source of high-quality proteins, essential amino acids, vitamins and minerals. Different egg products :
  • - Liquid eggs, frozen eggs, dried egg products (whole egg powder, egg yolk powder, egg albumin powder). Advantages :
  • - Convenience, extended shelf life, improved food safety, easier to incorporate into recipes. (nutritional significance- (2 Marks) , Different egg products- (2 Marks) , advantages- (1 Mark) /
